title: Load-safe recovery: hidden preload, full wrench and guarded reaction witnesses
status_authority: Whole supplied scientific sources at exact scope; no Capital scientific model execution or independent audit.
reported_status: ROOT supplies a restricted full-wrench linear plate construction in which matched opposed internal preloads leave net point reactions and complete linear stiffness unchanged while crossing individual-member capacity. A coaxial matched-law realization states its elastic/contact/compression assumptions. A separate introduced guarded-flexure screen quantifies force error and material requirements. No universal sensing impossibility or jointly qualified recovery device.
scientific_scope_status: ROOT supplies a restricted full-wrench linear plate construction in which matched opposed internal preloads leave net point reactions and complete linear stiffness unchanged while crossing individual-member capacity. A coaxial matched-law realization states its elastic/contact/compression assumptions. A separate introduced guarded-flexure screen quantifies force error and material requirements. No universal sensing impossibility or jointly qualified recovery device. Three-point isotropic linear rigid-body spring model and exact opposed matched-law branches at the same effective point; individually constrained paths, known material/contact range and actual internal measurement or mechanical limiting. Guarded single-force-path witness must have no parallel bypass and a physically realized unloaded calibration gap supported elsewhere. Actual powered full-wrench exchange, tool access, reset and life remain obligations.

proof_availability.classification_scope: Linear elastic matching, coaxial cancellation and same effective point are essential. Finite spacing, geometric stiffness, mismatch, accessible internal strain or physical load limiting may remove ambiguity. Frozen radial-preload example neglects geometric stiffness and is not an all-probe theorem. Independent flexure is not jointly validated with rigid plate, not three-axis sensor or1kN250Nm exchange module. No measured life/material/sensorerror or full autonomous recovery.
